Description.SourceString:
Sometimes you just want to wear a cube on your head and call it fashion. There's no shame in that, we all have our quirks. Why, I like to strut around my house with a raven-shaped walking cane and top hat on and no one's calling me weird - true, it's because anyone that does so is kneecapped and thrown into my basement oubliette, but they learn from their mistakes over time. 

Haha, did I say basement oubliette? I meant something entirely sane and normal, you don't need to worry. 

Now, these bronze helms are the very peak of rectangular fashion and, for just a few bronze bars, they're very cost-effective.
